AccessorListBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of the accessor list for a property or indexer.

AttributeListBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of an attribute list applied to the following code element.

CastTypeBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of the type name used in an explicit cast expression.

CatchArgumentBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of the exception type and variable declared in a {c:color-purple keyword}catch{/c} clause.

CollectionExpressionBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of a collection expression, a shorthand syntax for creating a collection.

DeconstructionBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of the variables that receive values when a tuple or object is deconstructed.

InterpolationBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of an expression embedded inside an interpolated string.<break/>The expression is evaluated at runtime and its result is converted to text and inserted at this position in the string.

ParenthesizedExpressionBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of a parenthesized expression, used to control the order of evaluation.

TupleExpressionBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of the values grouped together to form a tuple.

TupleTypeBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of the element types that define the shape of a tuple type.

ArrayTypeFragment.Definition: A fragment of the array type syntax.

ImplicitArrayTypeFragment.Definition: A fragment of the implicit array type syntax.

AccessorBlockBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of an accessor method body.

ArgumentListBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of the arguments passed to a method or constructor call.

AttributeArgumentListBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of the arguments passed to an attribute.

IndexArgumentListBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of the index or key used to access an element from a collection.

ParameterListBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of the parameters defined in a method or constructor signature.

TypeArgumentListBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of the type arguments supplied to a generic type or method.

TypeParameterListBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of the type parameters declared by a generic type or method.<break/>

CatchBlockBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of the code that runs when a matching exception is caught.

ElseBlockBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of the code that runs when the {c:color-purple keyword}if{/c} condition is false.

IfBlockBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of the code that runs when the {c:color-purple keyword}if{/c} condition is true.

LambdaExpressionBlockBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of a multi-statement lambda expression body.<break/>Unlike an expression-bodied lambda, a block body can contain multiple statements, local variables, and an explicit {c:color-purple keyword}return{/c} statement.

TryBlockBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of the code that is monitored for exceptions.<break/>If an exception is thrown inside this block, execution stops immediately and jumps to the matching {c:color-purple keyword}catch{/c} block.

ConditionBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of the condition that controls whether the following code is executed.

ContextBlockBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of a block that runs under a special execution context.

DeclarationBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of a type, member, or namespace declaration body.

DefaultExpressionBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of the type argument in a {c:color-blue keyword}default{/c} expression.

SizeOfExpressionBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of the type argument in a {c:color-blue keyword}sizeof{/c} expression.

TypeOfExpressionBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of the type argument in a {c:color-blue keyword}typeof{/c} expression.

InitializerBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of an initializer expression, which sets initial values during object or collection creation.<break/>This allows properties to be assigned and elements to be added at the same time an instance is created, without separate assignment statements.

LoopBlockBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of the code that executes on each iteration of the loop.

LoopControlBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of the logic that controls how many times the loop executes.

PatternBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of a pattern matching clause.

StatementControlBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of the expression that controls how a statement functions.

SwitchBlockBoundary.Definition: Marks the boundaries of a {c:color-purple keyword}switch{/c} statement or expression body.
